english.title: Light naked flame or undertake hot work using naked flame etc without permission - Port of Liverpool
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[lit a naked light or flame]_
(B)_[attempted to light a naked light or flame]_
(C)_[used a naked light or flame]_
(D)_[undertook an activity that involved hot work]_
(E)_[undertook an activity which was capable of causing a fire or explosion]_

within the dock estate of the Port of Liverpool without the prior permission of the Mersey Docks and Harbour Company Limited
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9 and 39(a) of the Port of Liverpool General Byelaws 2021.
